problem: I am thinking of studying at university in the Netherlands, but I'm not sure where to go. I am interested in universities that have a good reputation for research quality. According to the Times Higher Education World University Rankings of 2021, 2022, and 2023, are there any universities in the Netherlands that had a score of 60 or above for research in all 3 years? If so, please list them.
answer: Utrecht University, University of Amsterdam, Leiden University, Delft University of Technology
